methodologyNotes: Covers ready-to-run and kit radio-controlled ground vehicles (cars and trucks) sold at a published US MSRP, powered by an electric motor and battery. Excludes nitro/gas (internal-combustion) models, micro toy-grade novelties without published specs, drones, boats, and planes. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. scale is the model's fractional scale ratio as a string (e.g. '1/10', '1/8', '1/16'). vehicleType is an enum describing chassis category: monster-truck, short-course-truck, stadium-truck, buggy, truggy, on-road, or rock-crawler. driveType is an enum: 4WD or 2WD. motorType is an enum: brushed or brushless. topSpeedMph is the manufacturer-rated top speed in miles per hour on the included/stock power setup; null if not published. motorKv is the brushless motor's rated Kv (rpm per volt) as a number; null for brushed motors or if not disclosed. readyToRun is a boolean (true = RTR, assembled and radio-bound out of the box; false = builder kit). waterproofElectronics is a boolean for whether the receiver, ESC, and servo are rated waterproof. batteryIncluded is a boolean for whether a drive battery ships in the box. lengthInches is overall body/chassis length in inches. weightGrams is ready-to-run curb weight in grams.

products.name: Traxxas Slash 4X4
products.priceNote: AMain Hobbies product page for the exact model (TRA68054-1, Traxxas Slash 4X4 RTR 4WD Brushed) lists "Price: $299.95" — typical US retail/MSRP in USD. No separate MSRP figure was published; the official Traxxas page (traxxas.com) blocked automated fetching (HTTP 405).
products.provenance: The AMain Hobbies page (source) is the exact model TRA68054-1, "Traxxas Slash 4X4 RTR 4WD Brushed Short Course Truck," and lists a full verbatim spec table (1/10 scale, 4WD Short Course Truck, Titan 12T 550 brushed motor, waterproof XL-5 ESC/electronics, included Traxxas 7-cell NiMH battery + DC charger, Length 22.36 in, Weight 2.66 kg, Wheelbase 12.75 in) plus "Price: $299.95" — confirming both the model identity and the price. The rcvisions review (corroboration) independently confirms the brushed base Slash 4X4 uses the Titan 12T motor with XL-5 ESC and fully waterproof ESC/servo/receiver on a 4WD short-course platform, corroborating the drivetrain, motor type, and waterproof-electronics specs. The official Traxxas manufacturer page returned HTTP 405 to the fetcher, so the authorized full-line retailer AMain serves as the primary verifiable source; topSpeed and Kv are null because no manufacturer-rated top speed is published for the brushed base and the Titan 12T is a brushed motor.

products.name: Traxxas X-Maxx
products.priceNote: PCHobbies lists the X-Maxx 8S (TRA77096-4) at "$1,199.99" (US MSRP) and AMain Hobbies lists "$1,199.95" for the same model; reported the $1,199.99 MSRP figure, which appears verbatim on the PCHobbies (corroboration) page.
products.provenance: The manufacturer page (traxxas.com) returned HTTP 405 to the verbatim fetcher (bot-blocked), so I sourced from two authorized Traxxas retailers that both list the identical model, TRA77096-4 "Traxxas X-Maxx 8S 1/6 4WD Brushless RTR Monster Truck." The AMain Hobbies page (source) supplied the verbatim spec table — Scale 1/6, Length 30.67 inches (779 mm), Completion Level Ready-To-Run, VXL-8s Waterproof Electronic Speed Control, and batteries under "Needed To Complete" (so not included) — plus price $1,199.95. PCHobbies (corroboration) confirmed the same 1/6-scale 4WD brushless RTR identity, the "Up to 50+ MPH on 8S LiPo" rating, and price $1,199.99 (US MSRP); both pages confirm this is the current X-Maxx 8S belted-tire flagship, not the Ultimate variant or a smaller-scale sibling. Motor kV and curb weight in grams were not stated verbatim on either fetched page, so both are null.

products.name: Arrma Granite 4X4 3S BLX

products.provenance: The ARRMA manufacturer page (part ARA4302V3, titled "1/10 GRANITE 4X4 3S BLX") confirms this exact model and supplies the spec table: Scale 1/10, Vehicle Type Monster Truck, Drivetrain 4WD, Motor Type Brushless, Top Speed 50+, Spektrum Firma 3200Kv motor, Completion Level Ready-To-Run, Battery "Sold Separately", Product Length 18.74" (476mm); its ESC (BLX100 waterproof), receiver (SLR300 waterproof) and servo (SPMS651 waterproof) are all labeled waterproof. Product Weight is shown only as "6.23" with no grams unit, so weightGrams is left null rather than inferred. Tower Hobbies corroborates model identity and in-box contents (Spektrum Firma 3660 3200Kv motor, BLX100 2S/3S waterproof ESC, SPMS651 waterproof metal-geared servo), and US retailer RC Street Shop lists the exact model (ARA4302V3T1, Green) at $339.99 — the source for priceUsd.

products.name: Axial SCX10 III Base Camp
products.priceNote: US retailer price: AMain Hobbies lists the Axial SCX10 III "Base Camp" RTR 4WD Rock Crawler (AXI03027T3, Grey) at "Price: $349.99" (now marked "Discontinued Online"). The manufacturer Axial Adventure product page for the same model is marked Discontinued and shows no price, so the $349.99 figure is taken verbatim from the AMain corroboration page.
products.provenance: The Axial Adventure (manufacturer) product page for the SCX10 III Base Camp 4X4 RTR (item AXI03027T1) confirms model identity and provides the full PRODUCT SPECS table: Scale 1/10, Vehicle Type Rock Crawler, Drivetrain 4WD, Motor Type Brushed, Completion Level Ready-To-Run, Product Length 20.75" (527 mm), and Product Weight 5 lb (2.3 kg); the page is marked Discontinued with no price. The AMain Hobbies retailer page for the same model (AXI03027T3, Grey) corroborates identical specs and states "Price: $349.99" (Discontinued Online), and notes the product was added to catalog on June 28, 2022 (release year 2022, supported by multiple verified-owner reviews dated 2022). Top speed and motor Kv are not published (brushed 540 motor), and because the receiver is only a "sealed receiver box" on a rig the manufacturer calls "water resistant" (not all electronics rated waterproof) waterproofElectronics is false; weight is given only as 2.3 kg (grams not stated verbatim) so weightGrams is null.

products.name: Axial SCX24

products.provenance: The manufacturer source (Axial Adventure) confirmed the exact model — "Axial 1/24 SCX24 Deadbolt 4WD Rock Crawler Brushed RTR," item AXI90081, the first/namesake SCX24 — and its PRODUCT SPECS table supplied every non-null value verbatim: Scale 1/24, Vehicle Type Rock Crawler, Drivetrain 4WD, Motor Type Brushed, Completion Level Ready-To-Run, Battery Included, Water-Resistant No, and Product Length 7.8". Top speed, motor Kv (brushed), and curb weight are not published, so they are null. products.name: Tamiya Grand Hauler
products.priceNote: US price from the Tower Hobbies (Horizon Hobby) product page for the "Tamiya 1/14 Grand Hauler 10X8 Semi Tractor Kit" (TAM56344), listed verbatim as $361.90. No official Tamiya America MSRP figure was stated on the fetched manufacturer page (Item 56344), so this typical US retail price is used.
products.provenance: The official Tamiya product page (Item No. 56344, "1/14 R/C Grand Hauler") confirms model identity as a 1/14-scale, ladder-frame R/C tractor-truck assembly kit powered by a Type 540 motor with rear 2-axle drive, and states that the transmitter, battery pack, and charger are included only for the Japan-market Item 56343 — so the international 56344 ships with no drive battery (batteryIncluded=false). The Tower Hobbies page for the exact same part number (TAM56344, "1/14 Grand Hauler 10X8 Semi Tractor Kit") corroborates the model and lists its US price verbatim at $361.90, explicitly tagging it "2WD," "Brushed," a builder "Kit," with a 7.2V-7.4V battery, ESC, radio and servos under "Needed to Complete." AMain Hobbies (also TAM56344) independently corroborated "Scale: 1/14," "Drive Type: 2WD," and "Motor: 540-brushed type." Length (692mm) and weight (approx. 3.9kg) are published by Tamiya only in mm/kg, so lengthInches and weightGrams are left null rather than converted; no top speed or motor Kv is published (it is a brushed-motor scale kit).

products.name: Redcat Ascent
products.priceNote: Redcat Racing manufacturer product page lists US MSRP $299.99 for the Ascent 1/10 (Includes 2.4Ghz Radio, Ready to Run, Battery and Charger Not Included). Amazon US customer reviews corroborate a ~$300 street price ("under 300 bucks", "Well worth the $300").
products.provenance: The Redcat Racing manufacturer page (H1 "Redcat Ascent 1:10 Scale Brushed Electric Rock Crawler", part RER22767) confirms this exact model — the 1/10 LCG brushed crawler, not the brushless Ascent Fusion or the 1/18 Ascent-18 — and its Tech Specs list a 42T RC550 Brushed Motor, 4 Wheel Drive, RTR with RTX-4C 2.4GHz radio, Battery "Not Included", and a US MSRP of $299.99. The Amazon US listing (Redcat Racing Store; Model Number "Ascent 1:10", Manufacturer Part Number RER22767, Scale 1:10 Scale, Is Assembly Required: No, Batteries are Included: No) corroborates the same model and its RTR/no-battery configuration, with reviews referencing a ~$300 street price. Length is published only in millimeters (444mm) and the manufacturer gives no RTR curb weight (Amazon's "10 Pounds"/"22 inches" are shipping-box figures), so lengthInches and weightGrams are left null rather than converted; waterproofElectronics is null because only the servo, not the ESC/receiver, is explicitly rated waterproof.
